facts.fact: The Treasury directorate (DGCPT) launched SenTrésor on 2 June 2025, a digital platform to pay state expenditure including salaries, allowances, pensions, scholarships and social aid, with instant receipt of payment.
The DGCPT says SenTrésor pays salaries and allowances, pensions, scholarships and social aid, and names village chiefs, students and salaried staff as beneficiaries.
